title: UsersReactivateInput
description: Runtime target. `userId` is the durable account id (`user:<id>`) in the RUN's tenant — a foreign or unknown id is a uniform not_found. When absent, the node reads the run's host-event trigger payload (`ctx.triggerData.payload.userId`) ONLY when the run was started by a `host.users.user.*` event (`triggerData.eventName`); a manual run's `inputs.payload` is never honoured (the executor mirrors `run.inputs` into `triggerData` on the manual lane, and this input schema does not declare it). Then the config fallback. Never an email or userName: the target is addressed by its opaque id only.
